name: 基于事件的收入确认 – 服务凭证 – IFRS (3M4)
name_en: Event-Based Revenue Recognition – Service Documents – IFRS (3M4)
description_en_html:
Overview

Event-Based Revenue Recognition allows you to manage revenue recognition for service contracts and service orders, using group ledger IFRS functionality. For a service contract, revenue is recognized over time based on the billing plan of the service contract item. For a service order, revenue is recognized based on an event, such as the completion of a service order, and the associated cost is recognized in the same period in which the revenue is recognized. Manual adjustments of revenue and costs are possible. In the Service Actuals app, revenue and costs on service documents are reported in real time and the margin can be easily analyzed. If necessary, period-end closing corrects real-time revenue recognition postings.

Key Process Flow

  • Monitor revenue recognition for service documents
  • Manage real-time revenue recognition issues
  • Run revenue recognition for service documents in period-end closing
  • Manage revenue recognition issues for service documents
  • Review service actuals

Business Benefits

  • Support time-based revenue recognition for service contracts based on the referenced billing plan
  • Ensure the matching between costs and revenue for service orders
  • Ensure correctness of posted values after period-end closing, with no separate settlement required
  • Automate recognition activities and reduce manual effort during the period and at period-end closing
  • Avoid the need for additional reconciliation
description_zh_html:
概览

基于事件的收入确认允许您使用集团分类账 IFRS 功能管理服务合同和服务订单的收入确认。对于服务合同，收入根据服务合同项目的开票计划随时间确认。对于服务订单，收入根据事件（例如服务订单的完成）确认，相关成本在确认收入的同一期间内确认。可以手动调整收入和成本。在“实际服务”应用中，实时报告服务凭证的收入和成本，并且可以轻松分析利润。如有必要，期末关账会更正实时收入确认过账。

关键流程流

  • 监控服务凭证的收入确认
  • 管理实时收入确认问题
  • 在期末关账时运行服务凭证的收入确认
  • 管理服务凭证的收入确认问题
  • 查看服务实际值

业务优势

  • 支持基于参考开票计划的服务合同的基于时间的收入确认。
  • 确保服务订单成本和收入之间的匹配。
  • 确保期末关账后过账值的正确性，无需单独结算
  • 在期间和期末关账期间，自动执行确认活动，并减少手动工作量
  • 避免需要附加对账
